properties.name: Pangu Creates the World
properties.summary: Pangu was born inside a cosmic egg of chaos. He grew for 18,000 years, pushing heaven and earth apart. When he died, his body became the world: breath became wind, voice became thunder, eyes became sun and moon, blood became rivers, and parasites on his body became humanity.

properties.name: Nüwa Creates Humanity
properties.summary: After Pangu created the world, the goddess Nüwa was lonely. She shaped humans from yellow clay — carefully crafting nobles by hand and flinging drops of mud for commoners. She also repaired the sky when it was torn, using five colored stones. With her brother-husband Fuxi, she established marriage and civilization.

properties.name: Journey to the West — Monkey King
properties.summary: Sun Wukong, born from a stone egg, achieved immortality and wreaked havoc in Heaven before being imprisoned under a mountain by Buddha for 500 years. Released to accompany the monk Xuanzang on a pilgrimage to India for Buddhist scriptures, he protected the monk through 81 trials with his magical abilities.

properties.name: Chang'e Flies to the Moon
properties.summary: The archer Hou Yi shot down nine of ten suns that were scorching the earth. He received the elixir of immortality but his wife Chang'e drank it and floated to the moon, where she lives forever with the Jade Rabbit. The Mid-Autumn Festival commemorates their eternal separation.

properties.name: Four Dragon Kings of the Seas
properties.summary: Four Dragon Kings rule the four seas surrounding China, controlling rain and weather. When they defied the Jade Emperor to bring rain to drought-stricken humans, they were transformed into four great rivers. The Dragon Kings' underwater crystal palaces are settings for many Chinese legends.

properties.name: Fu Xi and the Eight Trigrams
properties.summary: The sage-emperor Fu Xi observed patterns in nature — the markings on a dragon-horse, turtle shells, and the stars. He devised the eight trigrams (bagua), capturing the fundamental principles of reality: heaven, earth, fire, water, mountain, lake, wind, and thunder. These became the basis of the I Ching.

properties.name: Yu the Great Controls the Flood
properties.summary: Great floods threatened China. Yu's father Gun tried to stop them by stealing magic soil from heaven. He failed. Yu spent thirteen years channeling the waters through drainage, never visiting home even when passing by. He divided the land into nine provinces and became the first emperor of the Xia dynasty.

properties.name: Zhurong vs Gonggong — Battle of Fire and Water
properties.summary: The fire god Zhurong battled the water god Gonggong for supremacy. Defeated, Gonggong smashed his head against Mount Buzhou, one of the pillars holding up the sky. The sky tilted, causing floods and fires. Nüwa repaired the sky with five-colored stones and cut off a turtle's legs as new pillars.

properties.name: Legend of the White Snake
properties.summary: A white snake spirit transformed into a beautiful woman and fell in love with the mortal Xu Xian. They married and she used her powers to help the sick. The monk Fahai exposed her true form and imprisoned her under Leifeng Pagoda. Green Snake eventually freed her. Their love transcended the boundary between human and spirit.

properties.name: Hou Yi Shoots Down Nine Suns
properties.summary: Ten sun-birds, sons of the sky god Di Jun, decided to cross the sky together, scorching the earth. The divine archer Hou Yi was sent to discipline them. When they refused to return, Hou Yi shot down nine suns, leaving one to light the world. Di Jun was furious and banished Hou Yi from heaven.

properties.name: Nezha Roils the Sea
properties.summary: Nezha was born from a flesh ball after three years' pregnancy. As a child, he killed the Dragon King's son while bathing in the sea, causing cosmic outrage. To save his parents from divine punishment, he carved his own flesh from his bones and returned it to them. His master resurrected him with lotus flowers.
